summary: Treeline NE 23 deg pit at 2290 m: basal FC(DH) 0-23 cm (4F-) under a 'problematic' FC 2 mm layer 23-42 cm (4F, red-flagged) with CT22 and CT27 SP at its top (42 cm, 'Dec. 2nd layer'); 1F+/1F- FCxr 0.5 mm 42-60 cm, DF 60-70 cm (4F) and 15 cm of soft rimed PP on top with CT13 RP at 70 cm; HS 85 cm; PF 70, PS 25; no temperature profile
reading_issues: Hardness bars and layer boundaries measured from pixels against the chart axes (boundaries 23, 42, 50, 60, 70 cm). Glyphs: slash read as DF; the small square-with-rounded-top glyph at 42-60 cm read as FCxr; '+r' (plus with subscript r) read as rimed PP (stored as PP, as elsewhere in this dataset). Failure heights are the arrow heights (they match the '@Ncm' labels, i.e. height above ground). CT13 RP at 70 cm lies exactly on the DF/PP boundary, so layer_grain is left null. The two 42 cm tests are on the top edge of the red-flagged 23-42 cm layer; layer_grain is given as FC (the flagged layer), not the 42-50 cm FCxr layer above. 'Dec. 2nd layer' is a non-bold free-text comment on the CT22 test; it is kept in raw and as a named layer. The title and the chart Notes ('Opening at Treeline') place the site at treeline; no temperature profile.
